fields.why: 'Analyses conducted by grade and race/ethnicity' sits in the school-vs-community paragraph, right after the note that community respondents were more often Hispanic, so it most plausibly tests the setting contrast within grade and race strata (A). It could also just restate the later by-group comparison (B); the sketchy methods leave both defensible, with A's reading preferred.

'Cheaper' and 'easier to buy' are respondents' reasons for choosing bidis (price and market availability), not social or structural determinants offered as an explanation of an outcome or disparity; the brief excludes market availability without disparity framing.
